pwfs.info.formula.text: Person score = sum of (effective weight × task score) divided by the sum of effective weights, over the tasks that are scored. Effective weight = priority weight × planned working days × the share of the person (assigned days inside the period over the days of the task, times the share given and the factor of the role). Excused, not started or approved-cancelled tasks are left out of the denominator.
